question: On Intel-supplied production SPAs satisfying Gate 0 (>=2 titles, H(S_next|URL,H_K=3)>0.2 bits, leakage<40%, NL>=50, strata>=10, singleton<50%) with BrowserGym/AgentLab 1280x720 provenance, does history-conditioned CMI I(S_next;DOM_before|URL,H_K=3,Action_leakageFree) with frozen trajectory-grouped permutation (resampling unit trajectory_id, 1000 perms) and restored positive control (P(L flips)=0.3, DOM=SHA256(L||step_mod)) achieve BC PMI>=0.10 bits, Bonferroni p<0.005 and Delta accuracy>0.03 on >=1/2 SPAs (or >=2/3 if Q=3) for R1 or R2, and if falsified does barrier/committor (>=10 revisits to same URL,DOM with divergent futures) or timescale separation reveal beyond-memory dynamics with B-DOM-SIMILARITY executed as frozen?
hypothesis: On Intel-supplied production SPAs satisfying substrate gates (unique_titles>=2, title_entropy>0, H(S_next|URL,H_K=3)>0.2 bits computed on pooled NL transitions with >=5 per stratum, valid-only leakage<40%, NL>=50, strata>=10, singleton_SA_rate<50%) with BrowserGym/AgentLab 1280x720 observation capture (DOM bytes, AX tree, title, URL, action_target), DOM_before encodes latent session/state-regime information that factorization predicts: history-conditioned CMI I(S_next ; DOM_before | URL_before, H_K=3, Action_leakageFree) >0 with bias-corrected BC_PMI >=0.10 bits AND Bonferroni-corrected grouped permutation p<0.005 AND history+DOM Markov delta accuracy >0.03 (grouped p<0.05) on >=1/2 qualifying SPAs when Q in {1,2} or >=2/3 when Q=3, for at least one primary DOM representation (R1 visible_text_hash or R2 a11y_tree_hash). Mechanism: DOM_before proxies latent regime L (session/auth/cart/personalization) correlated with stochastic branch P(S_next | S_current, A, L) beyond what (URL,H_K=3,Action) already predicts. Correlated non-determinism predicts BC_PMI>0.10; the falsified independent per-step DOM observation noise model (EXP-PHYSICS-34764605162 0.004-0.025 bits p=1.0, R2 non-degenerate 0.0036 bits p=0.458) predicts I=0. Synthetic correlated positive control (branching FSM L persists 3 steps P(flip)=0.3, DOM=SHA256(L||step_mod_3), H=1.0 bit, leakage 0%, NL=200) must show BC_PMI>=0.5 bits raw p<0.005 d>2.0 delta>=0.10; independent-noise synthetic must show BC_PMI<=0.05 bits p>0.10.
falsifier: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if on ALL qualifying production SPAs meeting gates, for BOTH primary DOM representations R1 and R2, BC_PMI <=0.05 bits OR Bonferroni p>=0.005 OR delta accuracy <=0.03 (grouped p>=0.05), i.e., sig count =0 under primary decision rule. This falsifies correlated DOM-state factorization via R1/R2 hash representations on this production SPA regime, bounded to tested SPA types and representations; it does NOT falsify barrier/committor or timescale programs which are evaluated exploratory on same substrate. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if substrate Gate 0 fails (<1 SPA qualifies: titles>=2, H>0.2, leakage<40%, NL>=50, strata>=10, singleton<50%), OR positive correlated control fails (BC<0.5 bits or raw p>=0.005 or d<=2.0 or delta<0.10), OR null controls degenerate (null_std==0 with singleton>50% or |null_mean|>=3*null_std), OR preprocessing fit on test, OR site identity leaks, OR resampling unit not trajectory_id. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST only if primary thresholds met on >=1/2 SPAs (Q=1-2) or >=2/3 SPAs (Q=3) for R1 or R2 with BC>=0.10 AND Bonferroni p<0.005 AND delta>0.03 and all pipeline gates pass.
baselines: B-HISTORY-MARKOV (strong Markov): P(S_next | URL_before, H_K=3, Action_leakageFree) majority-vote predictor trained on train split grouped by trajectory_id 70/30; primary comparison baseline for beyond-memory dynamics; expected accuracy = history-conditioned determinism floor; DOM must exceed this by delta>0.03.

B-ACTION-FREQ-SHUFFLE: within-strata shuffle of DOM_before labels AND separate within-strata shuffle of S_next labels; frequency-only predictor P(S_next) accuracy =1/|S_next| and action-frequency predictor; tests whether PMI is merely action-frequency effect; same strata, grouped permutation, same seeds.

B-DOM-SIMILARITY (kNN/Jaccard ordinary similarity null): nearest-neighbor predictor using TF-IDF cosine or Jaccard over DOM visible_text (R1) / title / a11y text, k=5, predicting S_next via similarity without history conditioning; MUST be executed as frozen and compared to history-conditioned CMI gap; history-conditioned CMI must beat similarity alone to claim beyond-memory dynamics.

B-TRAJECTORY-MEMORY: exact memorization of (URL, H_K=3, Action)->S_next from train trajectories (replay baseline); tests whether DOM adds beyond trajectory memory; computed separately, not asserted equal to B-HISTORY-MARKOV.

B-SITE-LEAKAGE-DIAGNOSTIC: action_with_target_href (leaky A_leaky = A + href) vs action_leakageFree (kind+target_sig without href/URL); reports leakage inflation delta = PMI_leaky - PMI_leakageFree (calibrated BC); valid inference uses leakageFree PMI alone; quantifies target leakage contribution.

B-INDEPENDENT-NOISE-SYNTHETIC: locally-hosted Express SPA with independent per-step DOM variant draw i.i.d. per step independent of latent L (parent EXP-PHYSICS-34764605162 replication) expected BC_PMI~0 (0.004-0.025 bits) on same pipeline with trajectory-grouped null; contrastive null showing correlated model is distinct; non-degenerate R2 calibrates threshold.
B-RANDOM-DOM: DOM_before replaced by SHA-256(random_counter monotonic) independent of state/action/stratum; expected BC_PMI~0 within 3*null_std; tests estimator bias floor.
positive_control: Synthetic correlated SPA (3-state branching FSM, latent L in {A,B} persists 3 steps with P(L flips)=0.30 per step exactly as frozen, URL=hash(step_mod_3), DOM_before=SHA256(L || step_mod_3) concatenated, S_next=(step+1 mod 3, L_next) branched by L, H(S_next|URL,H_K=3)=1.0 bit by construction, leakage 0%, NL=200, seeds PYTHONHASHSEED=0 numpy 42). Pipeline must detect BC_PMI >=0.50 bits, raw permutation p<0.005 (Bonferroni not applied to single control; raw p floor at N=1000 is 0.001 so 0.005 is reachable), Cohen d>2.0, and history+DOM accuracy exceeds history-only by delta>=0.10 with grouped permutation p<0.01. Validates estimator sensitivity to correlated non-determinism when it exists; failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (pipeline blind). Construction MUST be P=0.30 and DOM=SHA256(L||step_mod) exactly; any outcome-informed change is a protocol violation.
null_control: Two nulls must both pass for valid inference: (1) Shuffled-DOM within (URL,H_K=3,Action) strata on EACH qualifying production SPA: within-strata cross-trajectory grouped permutation of DOM_before labels preserving stratum sizes and within-trajectory DOM sequences (resampling unit trajectory_id, 1000 perms seed 42); valid null centering requires |null_mean|<3*null_std AND null_std>0.01 AND Bonferroni p>0.10; degenerate null (null_std==0 or singleton_SA_rate>50% making permutation invariant) => MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification. (2) Independent-noise synthetic SPA (same FSM as positive but DOM variant drawn i.i.d. per step independent of L, seed 42) must show BC_PMI <=0.05 bits AND p>0.10 (replicating parent 0.004-0.025 bits and R2 0.0036 bits p=0.458 non-degenerate); valid for all representations; degeneracy on constant DOM (R3) triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that representation, not PASS. Frequency null P(S_next) accuracy=1/|S_next| also reported. Singleton-strata rate>50% makes permutation degenerate => MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity: Gate 0 — Substrate qualification (Intel dependency, binding): Intel must supply manifest intel_spa_manifest.json with provenance (dataset revision hash, capture date, BrowserGym/AgentLab version, viewport 1280x720). Each entry records site_id, raw_transitions_path, n_raw, n_NL, leakage_validOnly, unique_titles, title_entropy, H_Snext_given_URL_HK3, strata_count, singleton_SA_rate, provenance hash. SPA qualifies ONLY if after leakage-free filtering: unique_titles>=2 (title_entropy>0), H(S_next|URL,H_K=3)>0.2 bits (plug-in entropy on NL transitions with >=5 per stratum; if <5 per stratum for all strata => H undefined => disqualified), leakage_validOnly<40% (normalized target_href==normalized state_after_url among transitions where action has href, link_click vs non-link share reported), NL>=50 non-leakage transitions, strata_count>=10 unique (URL,H_K,Action) strata, singleton_SA_rate<50%. If 0 SPAs qualify => MEASUREMENT_INVALID substrate_unavailable, publish gate0_table.json, do not test H_primary; handoff requests Intel branching title-varying SPAs. Max 3 qualifying SPAs for cost; if >3 take top-3 by H*NL.

Gated execution: if Gate 0 fails, do not evaluate primary hypothesis; record MEASUREMENT_INVALID with unresolved substrate; do not substitute locally-hosted/TodoMVC/Express SPAs (forbidden by this gate).

Data — production trajectories: reuse Intel BrowserGym/AgentLab trajectories where manifest hash verified; if manifest absent, DO NOT self-collect production sites as substitute without re-freeze; execution must halt as MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Synthetic controls are local only (seeds deterministic) and do not satisfy Gate 0.

State S_next (operational): primary S_next_primary = SHA256(normalize(URL_after) || '|' || normalize(title_after)) where normalize(URL)=lowercase, strip query params ?session=/?token=, preserve SPA hash fragment #/, strip trailing slash; normalize(title)=trimmed lowercased truncated 200 chars. Exploratory variants reported: S_URLonly, S_URL_DOMhash. Title variation is the Gate 0 discriminator; S_next is distinct timestep from DOM_before (no post-state leak).

Action A_leakageFree (operational): A=(primitive, target_sig) where primitive in {click, fill, navigate, select, submit, hover} and target_sig=role+name+testId+aria-label (never href/URL/src); link target_href equality never enters A. Diagnostic A_leaky=A+href computed only for B-SITE-LEAKAGE gap. Action distribution per SPA reported; policy regularity separated from environment dynamics.

DOM_before representations (operational, tested independently not ensembled): R1 visible_text_hash=SHA256(visibleText[0:5000] innerText from BrowserGym DOM snapshot), R2 a11y_tree_hash=SHA256(serialized AX tree role/name/value up to 5k chars), R3 title_before exact string equality (discretized by identity), R4 combined_hash=SHA256(R1||R2). Numeric structural features exploratory only (previously degenerate). Raw observables preserved (dom_bytes, a11y_bytes, title string) with documented truncation; hash collision and truncation loss disclosed. Primary claim requires R1 or R2 only.

History H_K=3 (operational): H_K=(last 3 leakage-free actions + last 3 URL_before+title_before states) truncated to 3 steps; strata key C=(URL_before_normalized, H_K_actions) where URL_before_normalized is URL_only without title to avoid state leakage into condition. Rare strata <5 transitions excluded from PMI point estimate but counted in validity_notes; strata_count and singleton rate reported.

Estimator (operational): history-conditioned CMI I(S_next; DOM_before | C) where C=(URL_before,H_K=3,Action). Plug-in with Laplace alpha=1.0 plus Miller-Madow bias correction per stratum entropy, weighted by stratum size. BC_PMI = observed PMI - mean(permuted PMI) where permuted = within-strata cross-trajectory grouped permutation (1000 perms seed 42 group=trajectory_id, shuffle DOM_before labels within strata preserving stratum sizes and within-trajectory sequences). Report both Laplace alpha=1.0 and nosmooth alpha=0 sensitivity; leakage diagnostic uses same estimator (not uncorrected simple plug-in).

Split integrity: preprocessing (discretization, TF-IDF vocab for B-DOM-SIMILARITY) fit on TRAIN trajectories only; stratified 70/30 train/test split by trajectory_id (grouped); holdout test used only for accuracy delta B-HISTORY-MARKOV comparison (acc_history vs acc_history_dom, delta, permutation p for delta); PMI permutation uses pooled NL but grouped by trajectory. Site identity never enters features; site_task leakage check performed.

Sampling integrity: Browser policy documented (Playwright crawler depth 3-5, 50 trajectories/SPA, 10 steps/trajectory, jitter 50-150ms uniform for any local synthetic only; production policy from Intel manifest provenance); policy action distribution reported and separated from environment dynamics; determinism via PYTHONHASHSEED=0, numpy seed 42, sklearn KMeans random_state 42 if clustering used; Python hash() not used as seed.

Uncertainty integrity: resampling unit = trajectory_id (grouped permutation, not transition); correlated transitions within trajectory not treated as independent; no Gaussian jitter bootstrap; report 95% CI via grouped permutation percentiles (2.5th/97.5th) not Gaussian; Bonferroni over Q_spas * n_primary_representations (R1,R2 => max 3*2=6, alpha 0.05/6=0.0083 rounded to frozen 0.005 for conservatism); report raw p = (1+#{perm>=observed})/1001 and Bonferroni p = min(1, raw*6). Positive control uses raw p<0.005 (single test, reachable at N=1000 floor 0.001).

Representation integrity: raw observables preserved or documented truncation; derived hashes document loss (hash collision, 5k truncation); result must survive at least one legitimate representation (R1 or R2) with same substantive direction under nosmooth sensitivity.

Strong null centering: null distribution is empirical within-strata grouped permutation; null_std must be >0.01 for valid centering; degenerate null (|null_std|==0 due to singleton strata or constant DOM) => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that stratum/representation; do NOT encode as scientific falsification; audit recomputation with grouped vs item-level must be disclosed.

Auditability: all raw transitions, hashes, strata tables, permutation distributions, code paths committed with sha256 in provenance.json; execution must be re-executable from frozen commit yielding byte-identical raw_cmi_results.json aside from elapsed.

Exploratory barrier/committor and timescale on same substrate (if primary FALSIFIED): barrier/committor requires >=10 revisits to same (URL_before, DOM_before) state with divergent futures to estimate committor variance/bimodality; timescale requires dwell-time distribution and autocorrelation of S_next; report feasibility metrics (branched_revisit_count, divergent_future_rate, dwell_time histogram, autocorrelation) regardless of primary outcome; do not claim beyond-memory dynamics from these without predeclared thresholds (committor variance >0.10 with permutation p<0.05, or timescale separation heavy-tail); they are orthogonal to pooled density divergence.
decision_rule: Gate 0 substrate: if 0 qualifying SPAs (titles>=2, H>0.2, leakage<40%, NL>=50, strata>=10, singleton<50%) => MEASUREMENT_INVALID substrate_unavailable, no C-WEB-DYNAMICS update. Else if positive_control fails (BC_PMI<0.50 bits OR raw p>=0.005 OR Cohen d<=2.0 OR delta<0.10) => MEASUREMENT_INVALID pipeline_blind. Else if null_control degenerate (null_std==0 or |null_mean|>=3*null_std or singleton_rate>50% making permutation invariant) on primary representations => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that representation. Else primary: for each qualifying SPA and each primary representation R in {R1,R2}, compute BC_PMI, Bonferroni p (raw*Q*2), Cohen d, 95% CI, delta_accuracy = acc_history_dom - acc_history with grouped permutation p_delta. Define sig(SPA)=1 if EXISTS R in {R1,R2} with BC_PMI>=0.10 bits AND Bonferroni p<0.005 AND delta_accuracy>0.03 with p_delta<0.05 AND null_std>0.01. Let Q=#qualifying, S=sum sig. If Q>=3 and S>=2 => SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST (correlated factorization demonstrates beyond-memory dynamics on production SPAs in this regime, bounded to tested SPA types and R1/R2). If Q in {1,2} and S>=1 => SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST (bounded to Q SPAs). If S==0 => FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (no DOM-before latent-state factorization beyond memory on these SPAs/representations via R1/R2; bounded to hash-based DOM, not global Web). If 0<S<threshold => MIXED/INCONCLUSIVE (partial evidence, report per-SPA table, do not update claim beyond HYPOTHESIS). Exploratory contingency (only if S==0 and pipeline gates passed): evaluate barrier/committor (branched revisits >=10 to same (URL,DOM) with divergent futures => estimate committor variance; SURVIVES only if variance>0.10 with grouped p<0.05 and bimodal) and timescale separation (dwell-time heavy tail or autocorrelation separation); report metrics regardless; these do NOT alter primary FALSIFIED verdict but inform orthogonal pivot per director_mandate. B-DOM-SIMILARITY, B-ACTION-FREQ-SHUFFLE, B-TRAJECTORY-MEMORY must be executed in all cases (frozen); failure to execute => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that baseline comparison, not silent omission.
product_consequence_positive: SURVIVES validates a mechanical prior beyond memory/similarity: DOM_before factorization captures latent session/state regime on production SPAs (e.g., auth tier, cart/user-dependent content, personalization) with >=0.10 bits and >3% accuracy gain beyond history Markov and beyond ordinary DOM similarity. SPIDER should distill DOM_before latent-state detectors as applicability guards for parameterized mechanisms (precondition: DOM_before regime) and freshness verification sentinels (DOM_before change signals regime shift requiring re-validation), and prioritize Intel BrowserGym/AgentLab trajectory collection on title-varying branching sites (shopping/account/personalized) for Graph/Product. Next: quantify factorization scope across site types (which DOM signals/latent states generalize), measure cross-site holdout transfer, and test delta-repair amortization when latent state drifts.
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING bounds C-WEB-DYNAMICS for this factorization program on tested production SPA regime via R1/R2 hash representations: DOM_before provides no predictive information beyond (URL,H_K=3,Action) even with H>0.2 non-determinism and valid null centering. Excludes independent-noise and correlated-proxy via these hash DOM representations on these SPA types; does NOT close barrier/committor or timescale programs. SPIDER should NOT invest in DOM_before latent-state detectors via hash representations as mechanical priors; attribute prior PMI failures to environment class, not estimator choice alone. Physics must pivot per director_mandate to next orthogonal program on same substrate: barrier/committor identifiability from branched evidence (>=10 revisits to same URL,DOM with divergent futures, test committor variance/bimodality) or characteristic timescale separation (autocorrelation / dwell-time spectra) — both test structure without density divergence and without pooled TV/KDE/binned PMI. Graph/Product continue on trajectory-memory/retrieval without physics prior.
estimated_cost: Low-medium: no LLM calls; BrowserGym/AgentLab trajectory reuse if Intel manifest exists (0 collection hours, analysis only); if manifest newly available, collection reuse verification only (hash check). Analysis: Python stdlib + numpy/scipy/sklearn 1.9 (<30 min CPU for 1000 grouped perms x max 6 primary configs =6000 PMI fits + synthetic controls + 4 baselines, plus delta accuracy permutations). Memory <8 GB, no GPU, total <4h wall-clock, deterministic seeds 42. Cold start with no manifest terminates in <10 min as MEASUREMENT_INVALID with gate0_table.
expected_information_gain: Very high and tunnel-breaking: first orthogonal falsification beyond 59 synthetic-dominated C-WEB-DYNAMICS experiments (58 synthetic-only, one narrow 2D SURVIVES, complementary blind spots kNN fails scaling rho=-0.12 vs KDE fails rotation rho=0.286, 95% pooled attenuation, independent-noise falsification at 0.004 bits bakes in null). Directly tests the only surviving plausible beyond-memory mechanism flagged open after audit (correlated non-determinism where DOM_before proxies persistent latent L) on director-mandated substrate where effect is expressible: Intel production SPAs with title variation, H>0.2 branching, NL>=50, leakage<40%, 1280x720 AX tree provenance. Uses corrected trajectory-grouped permutation (fixes audit FINDING-2 item-level shuffle), restored positive control P=0.3 DOM=SHA256(L||step_mod) (fixes FINDING-3 outcome-modified control), reachable Bonferroni criterion (fixes FINDING-4 unreachable p<0.001), and mandatory B-DOM-SIMILARITY/B-ACTION-FREQ-SHUFFLE/B-TRAJECTORY-MEMORY execution (fixes FINDING missing baselines). Either SURVIVES (first real-SPA beyond-memory dynamics, product-usable detector, expands claim ceiling beyond synthetic 2D) or FALSIFIED (closes hash-DOM factorization path, forces barrier/timescale pivot per director_mandate) changes C-WEB-DYNAMICS claim and product decision. MEASUREMENT_INVALID (substrate_unavailable) is also informative: it preserves epistemic discipline by refusing false negative from TodoMVC degeneracy and documents exact Gate 0 gap for Intel. Marginal gain vastly exceeds another synthetic TV/KDE/binned tuning at n=500/1000 (CV>0.5 tunnel).
